title: spec(view): FormSectionSchema.columns drops default(1) — an undeclared section density is the renderer's (by available width), a declared one is the author's ceiling (objectui#12521 fork)
body:
Filing gate: the spec half of a maintainer ruling on a fork of objectui#12521. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`). ⛔ Not a claim. The grade follows objectui#12521 (`priority:p1`); triage adds `target:` as it sees fit.

**The ruling.** objectui#12521's letter B (ruling `6203721639`, item 3) asked for one re-check before objectui PR #12546 lands: its "no columns declared ⇒ two per row" default against `FormSectionSchema.columns`' `default(1)`. The seat raised the conflict early, so that it can ride the same spec release as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734. The maintainer answered in this seat's session on 2026-10-15, without a decision card: 「不用决策卡，我同意 b) 改协议（推荐）： 去掉分节 columns 的 default(1)」. The record is on objectui#12521.

## What the ruling binds

- **The change.** `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` `FormSectionSchema.columns` (`:3783`–`:3789` on `origin/main`): drop `.default(1)`. The key stays optional, with values 1–4; the string spellings keep their transform, which must pass `undefined` through.
- **The meaning, stated in the describe and the docblock:**
  - A declared `columns` is the author's ceiling: at most that many fields per row where the container is wide enough. A renderer collapses it on narrow containers.
  - An undeclared `columns` is the renderer's choice, by available width.
  - No pixel or breakpoint value enters the protocol.
- **Why.** Today the two levels disagree:
  - `FormViewSchema.columns` (`:4320`) is optional, with no default;
  - a section's `columns` is `default(1)`.

  So after parse, a renderer cannot tell "the author wants one column" from "the author said nothing". On a wide dialog the second reads as one long column.
- **What moves with it:** tests, docs and generated artefacts (the JSON schema, the authorable-surface baselines). The changeset carries a BREAKING line: a parsed section without `columns` no longer carries `columns: 1`.

## Measured (this act)

- **objectstack:** `packages/*/src` readers of a form section's `columns` outside `view.zod.ts`: 0 (grep `section(s)?.columns`).
- **objectui:**
  - `metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx:1577` reads `s.columns ?? 1`;
  - plugin-form's sectioned layout reads it too, and objectui PR #12546 carries the renderer side (an undeclared density draws two per row from `@md`).
- **HotCRM:** 70 of 70 authored form sections declare `columns`, so it is unaffected.

## Release

objectstack-ai/objectstack#23734 (letter B's spec half, in flight) changes `record-surface.ts` for the same objectui card. Shipping both in one spec release saves objectui a second bump. objectui#12521 is `Blocked-by:` both.

Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by face (`packages/spec/src/**`).

Dedupe: objectstack open titles read for "section columns default", "FormSectionSchema" and "form columns" in this act: none.
